name: Judika Sihotang
bio: Judika Sihotang is an Indonesian singer and actor.

credits.title: Coming Home
credits.overview: A prominent young professional residing in Jakarta is abruptly recalled to his ancestral North Sumatra homeland by his patriarch to campaign for public office, where his political ambitions intersect with a transformative romantic awakening centered on the Batak customs he long neglected.

credits.title: Toba Dreams
credits.overview: A retired Sergeant, Tebe, returns to his hometown with all of his little family members and all his dreams but his eldest son follows the wrong path.

credits.title: Water & Fire
credits.overview: Three new firefighters from different walks of life must put aside their personal dramas and carry out treacherous rescue missions.

credits.title: Crazy Love
credits.overview: Kumbang (Adipati Dolken) and his three friends, Abdu (Kemal Palevi), Daniel (Herichan), and Basuki (Zidni Adam), are always causing havoc at school. credits.title: The Tarix Jabrix 2
credits.overview: The members of the Tarix Jabrix motorcycle gang finished high school and agreed to study in Jakarta. They are shocked at the major changes compared to their life in Bandung.

credits.title: Fire Squad
credits.overview: Four students, Gito, Dede, Kuncoro, and Rojak, are hired as part-time firefighter at the Fire Department. They were given the task of caring of an old fire engine.
